name: rush
description:
Some days shift your direction without warning.

After a conversation with @soothebyhendrix about music, healing, and building new systems for artists, we went back to my spot and started creating. We found a vocal asking, “why you always gotta be in such a rush?” and built the whole track around it in a couple hours.

Not long after, I spoke with @marilyn.pham about her commitment to releasing every month. It made me question my own hesitation.

This is me choosing consistency.

This year, every track will release first on [@subvert](https://zora.co/@0xa2593edc48846fcef323396f8da6bf1e136192bb). It’s a collectively owned co-op music platform (bandcamp alternative) I joined as a founding member because I believe artists need real ownership and alternatives to the current streaming system. Make sure you check them out and get ready for some more music from me 🕺💜

“rush”
03/01 — Subvert exclusive
03/15 — Bandcamp release 
04/01 — all platforms
